violations.text: No person certified in food safety were present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Hot dogs, sausages and Jalapeño torpedo roll were observed held at (113-129) degrees Fahrenheit. PIC reheat various products at time of inspection. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The following equipment/parts were not in good repair: -Door gasket located on walk-in cooler -lowboy #1 behind front counter, TCS foods shall not be stored in unit until unit is adjusted/serviced and maintains temp. 41 degrees fahrenheit and below. Unit temp. was observed at 50 degrees. All TCS foods were moved to colder refrigeration at time of inspection. Equipment/parts shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026
The receptacles in the toilet rooms are lacking a cover/lid. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026
The outside dumpster is not covered/closed. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Observed dumpster area with accumulation of debris at time of inspection. 5-501.115 Maintaining Refuse Areas and Enclosures. A storage area and enclosure for REFUSE, recyclables, or returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items, as specified under § 6-501.114, and clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

The floors in the following areas has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris: -on side of walk-in cooler -inside walk-in cooler -behind and underneath big gulp and slurpee machines -behind and underneath hot hold units in front The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
The walk-in gasket was observed in poor repair. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2025

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by marketing signage. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Staff removed during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2024

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was under 200 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200 ppm. PIC to contact service and/or refill dispenser. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2024
Gaskets located on the walk-in cooler was not in good repair. PIC Stated work order has been placed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2024
The receptacles in the toilet rooms are lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2024
The refuse area had a small accumulation of leaf litter and vegetation overgrowth. Refuse areas to be maintained clean to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2024
